entries.name: player1
entries.notes: Player 1 (Player*); [player + 4] is its car. A car: +0x30 its input block, +0x60 position (f32 x3, world, Z up), +0x70 velocity (f32 x3, world, m/s), +0x80 acceleration (f32 x3, world, m/s2, gravity excluded; checked live), +0x90 forward, +0xA0 left, +0xB0 up (unit rows), +0x110 spin (f32 x3, world, rad/s), +0x42C forward speed (m/s), +0x430 speed (m/s), +0x434 gear (s32: 0 reverse, 1 neutral, 2 first), +0x440 rpm (f32). Its input block: +0x1E0 steer (s16: +-8192 at full lock with a wheel, + left; checked live), +0x20C throttle, +0x210 handbrake, +0x214 brake (f32 0-1). From th0mk/nfsu2-web runtime/game.h, racecars.c (MIT).

entries.name: ff_manager
entries.notes: The game's force feedback manager. Per device slot s (0 the wheel): +0x2BA0 + 12s spring offset, coefficient, saturation (s32 x3); +0x2BB8 + 8s constant force magnitude (s32, +-10000); +0x2BC8 + 4s damper coefficient (s32). Found from the game's code (0x5C9150, 0x5C9380, 0x5C9590). docs/nfsu2/FINDINGS.md.
